title: Nova Scotia boil water advisory lift-within-30-days (duration to resolution)
domain: drinking water regulation - boil water advisory duration to lift (Nova Scotia, Canada)

jurisdiction.publisher: Open Data Nova Scotia / Nova Scotia Department of Environment and Climate Change (Environment and Energy portal category)

prediction_question: At the moment a boil water advisory is issued for a public registered or municipal drinking water supply in Nova Scotia - known then: site name, county, facility type, reason for the report, calendar season, and the prior advisory history of the same site/county computed only from earlier advisories - will the advisory be lifted within 30 days?
prediction_time: The advisory issue date (register column 'Date Advisory Issued', calendar day, America/Halifax). Every shipped feature must be a value fixed at or before that day: the issuing row's own site name, county, facility type, reason for the report, and derived calendar features; site/county history features may only use rows with an earlier issue date. The label window is the 30 days that follow the issue date. No part of the target window precedes the instant.
target_definition: Binary: advisory lifted within N days of issuance, N=30 primary (N=14 secondary; both base rates measured below). Label source columns: 'Date Advisory Removed' and 'Length of Advisory in Days' - label-only, excluded from shipped features. Publisher documents the censoring semantics on the dataset page: 'Values are not provided for boil advisories that are currently in effect.' (blank removal date = active). Scored rows require a removal date at the pinned vintage; censored rows are counted per window and excluded from scored sets, not treated as observed non-lifts.

eligibility.rule: Advisory has a parseable issue date; issued no later than the labeling cutoff (vintage date 2026-06-16 minus 30 days = 2026-05-17) so an unlabeled advisory cannot masquerade as a negative; scored windows: train 2008-2017, eval 2018-2020, holdout 2021-2024. Rows without a removal date at the vintage are censored and counted, never scored. 30 rows have no parseable issue date and are excluded (counted as hazards).
eligibility.vintage: Register content current as of 2026-06-16 (dataset page 'Current as of June 16, 2026'; CSV Last-Modified 'Tue, 16 Jun 2026 13:58:42 GMT'; changelog shows full refresh 'Inserted 2649 rows, Deleted 0' on that date). Discovery vintage fetched 2026-10-27: CSV 283,987 bytes, sha256 60f77ac4945ca824700f5bcd3eaf564f4e5c5d4ec3f08496e8dd796e7184a30a. Publisher updates quarterly; construction must re-fetch, pin the fresh vintage and sha256, and re-measure every count below.

construction_script: candidates/ns-bwa-advisory-lift-duration/source/build.py (construct-only; no performance metric) + source/score.py (references, post-acceptance only) + source/run.sh (fixed order construct -> qualify -> --accept -> references); bundle assembled by scripts/assemble-job.py with the canonical gate sha256 4fab8a34...
split_strategy: Cohort split on advisory issue year (disjoint calendar-year windows, both classes in every window). Computed from the full fetched CSV (sha256 60f77ac4...) and cross-checked against independent SoQL aggregates run against the live API (identical numbers). Censored rows excluded from scored sets with per-window counts. Clustered (site-repeat) counts recorded because advisories cluster by site: 586 / 286 / 551 distinct sites per window.

out_of_eligibility.note: Recent cohorts, mostly still active at vintage; excluded from the three scored windows.

splits.independence: Positives are spread over 19 issue years and both facility types; they cluster by site (2,649 advisories over 1,116 distinct site names; repeat advisories per site ~2.4x), so window independence is temporal and site-repeat must be reported in construction. A measured regime shift exists: mean advisory duration 47-65 days (2009-2018) vs 218 days (2020), 143 (2021), 101 (2022), 64 (2023) - the holdout window straddles the 2020-2022 duration spike, an honest distribution-shift difficulty that must be reported, not smoothed away.

measurements.register_totals: 2,649 advisories; 2,576 resolved (removal date present); 73 active/censored (removal blank); 1,116 distinct site names; facility types: Registered 2,491, Municipal 101, missing 57; reasons: Total Coliform Present 1,816, Chemical Exceedance 389, Other 186, E. Coli Present 83 + E.Coli Present 52 (spelling variants - same category), Lack of Disinfection 50, Failure of Treatment Processes 42, Ineffective Disinfection 14, others 13, missing 5.
measurements.hazards_measured: CSV dates are month-name text ('October 02 2025'), not ISO. 3 rows have NEGATIVE duration (removal date before issue): McIntyre's H. Cottages (Baddeck) -1, PID 50323732 -52, Naugler's Ultramar - Italy Cross -7 (construction must define the handling rule and record the row counts). 5 rows have 0-day duration. 30 rows have no parseable issue date. 57 rows missing facility type. 5 rows missing reason. Duration range -52 to 1,668 days. Site identity is messy by design (name variants for the same facility, PID-addressed sites) - no clean entity key; site-history features must be built with an as-of filter and a stated identity rule.
measurements.censoring_by_issue_year: 73 unresolved: 2013:1, 2017:1, 2020:1, 2021:4, 2022:1, 2024:5, 2025:11, 2026:19 + 30 rows with missing issue date (unknown vintage exposure). Publisher documents the semantics: blanks are advisories currently in effect.
measurements.dated_example: Named timezone America/Halifax (register records calendar days). Prediction instant 2024-08-31 (Maple Meadows Campground Inc, INVERNESS COUNTY, Registered, 'Total Coliform Present' - row verified in the pinned CSV: issued August 31 2024). Feature event window: all register rows with issue date < 2024-08-31 (site's and county's earlier advisories only). First-available version: the single pinned vintage, content current as of 2026-06-16, fetched 2026-10-27, sha256 60f77ac4.... Target window: the 30 days following 2024-08-31, i.e. through 2024-09-30 (no part precedes the instant). Measured outcome: Date Advisory Removed = July 04 2025, 307 days -> lift30 label NEGATIVE. Second fixture (positive class): 'Canning, NS' (Municipal, Total Coliform Present), issued October 02 2025, removed October 03 2025, 1 day -> lift30 POSITIVE. Both rows verified in-file; fixture commands in notes.md.
measurements.cross_check: Publisher's own dataset page reports 'Rows: 2,649, Columns: 7' - exactly matches the fetched CSV (no missing rows). Page documents grain, 2006-current coverage, quarterly frequency and the blank-means-active censoring rule that the 73 measured censored rows follow. Changelog shows dated full refreshes (2025-10-14, 2026-06-16 'Inserted 2649 rows, Deleted 0'); whether Socrata restore points/revisions expose prior vintages is a construction-time check that would strengthen (not rescue) the as-of story - the task is declared retrospective on the pinned vintage regardless.
measurements.sibling_channels_checked_2026_10_27: Newfoundland & Labrador 'Boil Water Advisories' (opendata.gov.nl.ca file-id=17146, nl-oglnl, 53,342 bytes, bounded header+rows sample read): carries BOIL_ADVISORY_ISSUE_DATE and rich system features (SUPPLY_TYPE, SOURCE_TYPE, NUM_OF_WELLS, CHLORINATION, POPULATION_SERVICED, REGION_*) but NO lift/rescinded date column - cannot support the duration task (measured negative). Manitoba 'Current BWAPWS' (mb-omb): current advisories only, no lifts. Quebec (donneesquebec.ca, qc-cc-by): one city (Repentigny). ECCC/CESI 'Boil water advisories' (ca-ogl-lgo): national aggregate indicator CSVs only. The NS register is the only per-advisory machine-readable channel with lift dates found this tick - the provincial municipal-water channel the isc-ltdwa record named as its reopening condition.
measurements.extraction_cost: One 284 KB CSV GET plus 12 small SoQL calls; full local aggregate pass < 5 s on the coordinator. Construction needs no worker for the fetch; qualification runs on a worker per the standing order.

baseline_2026_10_29.finding: NO demonstrated headroom under this protocol. The runner's own baseline does not beat the best simple reference - it trails the one-line site-persistence rule (a shipped feature) by 0.1038 AUC and sits exactly at the calendar/identity control (+0.0011). Per dataset-qualification, a model below persistence is a recorded defect, not an encouraging result. This does not prove every competent model must lose: an agent that follows the shipped site-persistence feature starts at ~0.61, so the benchmark's baseline-to-reference gap is agent-visible - but the task's discriminative claim above simple references is not demonstrated.

contracts.redistribution: SUPPORTED - Open Government Licence - Nova Scotia v1.1 on the dataset's own page: copy, modify, publish, adapt, distribute for any lawful purpose including commercially; class A with the required attribution statement 'Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Nova Scotia' to be carried verbatim in LICENSE.md; source terms preserved, dataset labelled as derived.
contracts.prediction_timing: SUPPORTED AS A DECLARED RETROSPECTIVE TASK - the instant (issue date) precedes the entire 30-day label window for every scored row; every shipped feature is fixed at issuance (register columns of the issuing row + as-of history from strictly earlier rows). One pinned quarterly vintage (content as of 2026-06-16, sha256 recorded); the publisher documents blanks-as-active; no historical operational-availability claim is made; the register is revised in place, so a future re-fetch measures churn, not historical vintages. Socrata changelog/restore points are recorded as a construction-time check only.
contracts.target: SUPPORTED - label from 'Date Advisory Removed'/'Length of Advisory in Days' (excludable columns), measured on 2,576 resolved rows; censoring (73 active) is publisher-documented, counted per window, and separated from observed non-lift; eligibility cutoff (vintage minus 30 days) prevents recent unresolved advisories entering scored windows as false negatives.
contracts.split_capacity: SUPPORTED - measured from the full source: train 1,069 / eval 372 / holdout 886 labeled rows in disjoint issue-year windows with both classes in every window and year (lift30 rates 66.9 / 60.5 / 58.2%); clustered counts recorded (586 / 286 / 551 distinct sites); the 2020-2022 duration regime shift inside the holdout is a declared difficulty.
contracts.not_a_mirror: SUPPORTED (novelty_check verdict: no_precedent) - no ML-ready BWA-duration task exists anywhere found; prior art is descriptive; the in-repo ISC record defined and wanted this task but its source lacked lift dates; this candidate exists because the NS register carries them.
